summary_en: The video highlights the natural landscapes, river life, and unique cultural heritage of the Khmer community in Tri Ton, An Giang. Key visual scenes feature aerial views of the Ta Pa rice fields and turquoise lake, agricultural activities, the traditional Van Giao brocade weaving craft village, and sacred spaces in ancient Khmer temples like Xa Ton Pagoda, which preserves precious palm-leaf manuscripts.
